random.purpose: feature-identity control; different features per trial
random.note_v01: v0.1 had a fixed seed=0 bug. Fixed in v0.2 commit.

headline_results.as_of: v0.2 — random_policy seed bug fixed, L0 verified

caveats: Steering hook is not position-aware. It applies to entire layer-19 residual during the steered forward pass, not just the action-generation token.
Feature labels (e.g. 'invented_action_supp') are functional, not semantic. They describe behavioral effect, not what concept the feature encodes.
Lenient verifier accepts multiple copies of the target in cart. Strict verifier (cart_contains_target_exactly_once) added in v0.2.
ShopGym page summary lists target product from step 0; benchmark tests trap-avoidance, not target-discovery.
HUD steering controls are placeholders in v0.1. v0.2 plans a HUD-to-runner command channel.
